title: i-VI-III-VII in A minor (a chord loop for the preset demo)
about: One chord a bar, round and round: Am, F, C, G. Every preset plays one bar of it in a role that suits it. Written for this demo.
format: chords: one a bar, looped (a root A-G with # or b, then m for minor). roles: each role's phrase is a bar of [start beat, length in beats, [chord tones]], tone 0 the root, 1 the third, 2 the fifth, 3 the root an octave up, and so on; from: the lowest note the role's root may take. A preset's role is guessed from its name by the words in guess (first match), else default; higher moves a preset whose name has one of its words up by shift semitones; overrides set a role (and a shift) by patch or by "patch > preset". The drone role is for engines played on the black keys (a Drum map's rows): its tones count rows from the bar's chord. An engine with fewer voices than a phrase's chord plays its lowest tones.
